caption: The drawing depicts a single leather fire bucket, which is cylindrical in shape with a round open top and a handle attached to either side by metal rings. The overall color of the bucket is a dark green, with a red rim and base, and a reddish-brown handle. The bucket features painted decoration, including a yellow banner across the middle with the words "PROMPT AT DANGER" in capital letters. Above the banner, part of a name, "John Tyler," is painted in yellow. There is an image of orange and yellow flames depicted beneath the banner. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Fireman's Bucket
